newsitem.title: GERMANY: West German industry signals upswing-Ifo Institute.
newsitem.headline: West German industry signals upswing-Ifo Institute.

text.p: West German industry, production utilisation rates improving, showed firmer signs of economic recovery in the second quarter, the Ifo Institute said on Monday.

Average factory capacity utilisation was 85.5 percent at the end of June -- exceeding the 84.8 percent level from the end of the first quarter, and marking the highest rate in two years, Ifo said in a report.
But the rebound was still limited to industrial sectors, the institute said.

In capital goods production, capacity utilisation at the end of June improved to 84.7 percent, from 84.5 percent at the end of March. In intermediate goods, the rate rose to 85.3 percent from 84.2 percent and in durable goods to 86.8 percent from 85.9 percent.
But in consumer goods, utilisation was clearly weaker, with the second quarter's capacity utilisation rate falling to 84.4 percent from 86.5 percent in the first quarter, Ifo said.
